items.question: What single mantra and ritual bath does the renunciant instruct the brahmin to perform according to rule?
premises: The speaker promises to teach one mantra.
The addressee is instructed to bathe.
The bath must follow prescribed rule.
items.inference: The verse prescribes a one-mantra rite with rule-governed bathing.
uncertainties: The exact mantra is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: I will tell you one mantra; perform the bath according to rule.
